question: Which attendant goddesses must be worshipped in the new womb enclosure?
premises: The ritual location is the new womb.
An eightfold group is associated with that location.
inference: The worshipper should worship Brāhmī and the other mothers of the eightfold group in the new womb.
plain_english: One should worship Brāhmī and the other goddesses of the eightfold group in the new womb.
